name: Mip-NeRF 360 Sampling and Training
definition: Floaters are small disconnected regions of volumetrically dense space that explain a subset of input views but look like blurry clouds from other angles.
summary: Mip-NeRF 360 Sampling and Training optimizes unbounded radiance fields using disparity-linear parameterization and online distillation to prevent floaters and background collapse.
